headline: Senior Product Designer
summary: User-centric Product Designer with over 6 years of experience building high-impact digital products within Nepal's e-commerce and fintech landscapes. Expert in driving product strategy through user research, iterative prototyping, and the development of comprehensive design systems. Proven track record of improving conversion rates and user retention for platforms with over 1 million active users.

experiences.title: Senior Product Designer
description: Led the end-to-end redesign of the Daraz Mahotsav campaign landing pages, resulting in a 22% increase in mobile app click-through rates.
Established and maintained the 'Daraz-NP' design system, ensuring visual and functional consistency across Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Collaborated with regional product managers in South Asia to localize features for the Nepali market, focusing on cash-on-delivery trust signals.
Conducted usability testing sessions with over 50 participants to identify pain points in the checkout flow, leading to a 10% reduction in cart abandonment.

experiences.title: Product Designer
description: Conceptualized and designed the Khalti 'Utility Payments' interface, simplifying the process for electricity and water bill payments for thousands of users daily.
Partnered with the engineering team to implement a responsive design framework that improved performance on low-end mobile devices common in rural Nepal.
Executed high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes for the Khalti QR payment merchant onboarding flow.
Introduced weekly design critiques to the 5-person design team, fostering a culture of feedback and continuous improvement.

experiences.title: Associate UI/UX Designer
description: Designed user interfaces for SageFrame, an open-source CMS, focusing on administrative dashboards and module management.
Created visual assets and marketing collateral for various enterprise-level ERP solutions targeting international clients.
Assisted in gathering requirements from stakeholders and translating business needs into user flow diagrams.
Worked closely with frontend developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation of CSS and layout structures.
